LEE KONG CHIAN SCHOOL OF MEDICINE
PhD ADMISSION APPLICATION CHECKLIST
Applicants are to submit the following documents along with their application by the deadline.
Please note English translations should accompany supporting documents that are not in English.
No Checklist for All Applicants Checklist Box
1 Research Proposal
A brief research proposal (maximum of 2 pages) outlining the significance
and aims of the project.
2 Curriculum Vitae
Includes relevant research experience (attachment/internship) if any
3 Bachelor’s degree certificate
Master’s degree certificate (if applicable)
Original copy of the degree scrolls and a translated English version for
certificate that is not in English.
Applicants who have not yet graduated from their undergraduate
studies at point of application are to provide a Student Status Letter
issued by their university stating their name and enrolment status i.e.
start and expected completion date.
4 Bachelor’s degree Transcript
Master’s degree Transcript (if applicable)
Applicants are required to submit their full transcripts along with their
university’s Grading System and Honors Classification.
Applicants who have not yet graduated from their undergraduate
studies at the point of application are to provide their latest
transcript, along with Grading System and Honors
Classification.
5 Proof of Agreement for PhD Supervision
You are required to attach the email correspondence confirming the
proposed supervisor’s agreement from at least 1 proposed supervisor.
6 TOEFL iBT/ IELTS scoresheet
Compulsory for applicants whose medium of instruction is not English.
If your university's medium of instruction was fully in English, please contact
your university to request a proof letter and us the letter confirming your
medium of instruction.
1
7 GRE scoresheet
Highly recommended for applicants who are not graduates from
autonomous universities in Singapore.
8 NRIC/Passport copy
A copy of Singapore NRIC for Singapore citizens / SPR OR a copy of
the passport page showing nationality and personal details for
international applicants.
Singapore Permanent Resident applicants are also required to submit a
copy of their valid Re-Entry Permit.
9 To include the list of Publications, Conference Presentation and
Relevant Research Experience in the CV
Please provide a list of your publications and clearly indicate if you are the
first author, co-first author, or contributing author. Applicants are
encouraged to submit the list of their conference presentations where they
were the main presenter and the relevant research experiences.
10 Personal Statement
Please prepare a personal statement, 1-2 pages in length, which includes
the following: why you want to pursue a PhD at LKCMedicine, research
experience, motivations, and relevant skills.
11 Documentary Proof of Financial Support
Applicants who wish to opt for self-financed must submit documentary
evidence of their ability to support their study in the form of bank
statement.
12 2 Academic Referee Reports
2 Academic Referees' contact details to be provided in the admission
system. Applicant to ensure that referees submit their reports strictly within
the deadline.
